n0:createSxmlObject.n0:source: <VIEW xmlns="http://xmlns.oracle.com/ku" version="1.0"> <SCHEMA>%USER_NAME%</SCHEMA> <NAME>THERAPIST_TIERING_VIEW</NAME> <DEFAULT_COLLATION>USING_NLS_COMP</DEFAULT_COLLATION> <COL_LIST> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>THERAPIST</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>WEEK_OF_SESSION_MONTH</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>WEEK_OF_SESSION_YEAR</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>WEEK_OF_SESSION</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>NUM_CLIENTS</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>NUM_SESSIONS</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> </COL_LIST> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> <SUBQUERY>with tier_data_raw as ( select case_number, trunc(date_session, 'IW') week_of_session, trim( to_char(trunc(date_session, 'IW'), 'Month') ) week_of_session_month, to_number(to_char(trunc(date_session, 'IW'), 'yyyy')) week_of_session_year, nvl(s.therapist_id, c.therapist_id) therapist_id from sessions s join clients c using (case_number) ), tier_data_grouped as ( select therapist_id, week_of_session_month, week_of_session_year, week_of_session, count( distinct(case_number) ) num_clients, count(*) num_sessions from tier_data_raw group by therapist_id, week_of_session_month, week_of_session_year, week_of_session ) select upper( last_name || ', ' || first_name ) therapist, week_of_session_month, week_of_session_year, week_of_session, num_clients, num_sessions from tier_data_grouped join therapists on id = therapist_id</SUBQUERY> </VIEW>
